questions.prompt: Which numerical attribute type has a true zero and supports meaningful multiplication and division?

choices.response: Incorrect. Interval data has meaningful differences but no true zero, so ratios are not meaningful.
Correct. Ratio data has an absolute zero, so ratio statements and multiplication/division are meaningful.
Incorrect. Ordinal data is ordered but does not define meaningful numeric distances.
Incorrect. Nominal data is unordered categories and only supports equality checks.

questions.explanation: Ratio data has an absolute zero, so ratio statements and multiplication/division are meaningful.
